reviewer_notes.text: INTERIM SOLO REVIEW, pending independent re-review. Round 2 of PGP-1.03 rewords one requirement of T4. From: "docs/scope-one/RECONCILIATION.md maps every programme requirement against docs/scope-one/WBS.md as same, missing or conflicting, with a claim register naming each workstream (source: owner request of 31 Oct 2026)". The new text says a claim register naming each claim. The change removes the need for the published page to name a work stream by its owner label, which round 1 found to be a label of another agent; the register still names every claim and the criteria that the reconciliation has a claim register and states its headline counts are kept. The multiline flag was added to the four grep criteria of T3 and T4 that anchor on a heading, which makes the anchor match at a line start. SO-A-11 is cited for the register check script.
